j68ax06j.sourceDescription: Bring the rich colours of autumn into your home with this 50cm Autumn Wreath, beautifully decorated with an eye-catching combination of pumpkins, pine cones, maple-style leaves, berries and seasonal foliage. Featuring warm shades of orange, red, brown and gold, the full layered design creates a welcoming seasonal display that's ideal for celebrating autumn and the harvest season. With its generous 50cm diameter, this decorative wreath makes an attractive statement without overwhelming your space. Perfect for styling on front doors, internal doors, fireplaces, walls or as an autumn table centrepiece, it offers an easy way to add seasonal warmth to your home. Reusable and easy to display, this versatile autumn decoration can be brought out year after year for autumn and inspired décor. •Beautiful Autumn Wreath - A richly decorated seasonal wreath featuring colourful autumn leaves, miniature pumpkins, pine cones, berries and textured foliage in warm orange, red, brown and golden tones. •Generous 50cm Diameter - Measuring approximately 50cm across, this full and eye-catching wreath creates an impressive seasonal focal point for your home. •Versatile Autumn Decoration - Perfect for front doors, internal doors, walls, fireplaces, mantel displays and table centrepieces, allowing you to style it throughout your home. •Full and Layered Design - Packed with seasonal details and varied textures to create a fuller, more natural-looking autumn display with plenty of depth and visual interest. •Reusable Seasonal Decoration - A charming decoration that can be stored and reused each year, ideal for autumn decorating, harvest displays, seasonal parties inspired home décor. This product is intended for decorative purposes only and is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets. Small or detachable decorative components, including berries, miniature pumpkins, pine cones, leaves and foliage, may present a choking hazard. Keep away from naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other heat or ignition sources. Ensure the wreath is securely attached when displayed on doors, walls or other elevated surfaces to prevent it from falling. Do not place directly above or close to an active fireplace. Protect from prolonged exposure to adverse weather conditions. Regularly inspect for loose, damaged or detached components and discontinue use if damaged. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
